ruleDefinitions.name: Bitsadmin to Uncommon IP Server Address
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Bitsadmin connections to IP addresses instead of FQDN names Note: Unmapped fields: c-useragent, cs-host

sequences.query: (c-useragent = RGX("^Microsoft\\ BITS\\/") AND (cs-host = RGX("1$") OR cs-host = RGX("2$") OR cs-host = RGX("3$") OR cs-host = RGX("4$") OR cs-host = RGX("5$") OR cs-host = RGX("6$") OR cs-host = RGX("7$") OR cs-host = RGX("8$") OR cs-host = RGX("9$")))
